content: Skitter drops off a package for Rockman. Inside is exactly what he specified. Plus many buckles and straps and pockets to put things because Skitter assumes everyone carries all their shit on them like he does.
Thumper hops down the tree to go see what's happening in town.

Leaf and Thumper climb up on the platform, both exhausted. Before she falls asleep, she writes a note for Rockman to find.

``` Tomorrows the big day I guess! You probably already saw the bulletin board thing, but I talked to Solomon which was... Strange. Is it weird that I'd been hoping to talk to him for a while? Well, it went better than I thought it would thanks to Heki. I'm still not sure if I trust him, but he could be a big help if he's being genuine. Like I said, I'm trusting the rest of the town with that decision while I guard to forge. The Masons have already lost so much, we can't loose that too. I believe in you and Mello. I know I'll see you this weekend, and we'll get to dance and laugh together. I can't wait! Again, I love you so, so much! Goodnight!
~Leaf```
Leaf curls up in the blankets, leaving plenty of room for Rock when he gets back.

Rush floats to the platform. Rockman steps off and drops his gear, climbing into the blankets as he reads the note left for him. He embraces leaf knowing that a real chance of never seeing her again looms about. He silently sobs as he takes his mask off. If this night is to be his last, he would wish to Look at her with his own eyes. He studdies her sleeping face. Etching every detail into his memory. Tears roll quietly as he smiles. In goblin he whispers ||"I promise I will do my best to return to you tomorrow my Love. I wish I could offer assurance that i will. I love you with everything that i am. I will always be yours, my Little Leaf."||
(just got to campus!) Leaf holds and kisses Rock dearly before taking her place at The forge in <#733827764133822465>
(have some flavor text I'd like to post there when I get the chance 👍)
Rockman gets up, a single tear escapes him as he remembera Leaf getting up and leaving. He puts his mask back on, gathers his thing, and heads off

Rockman returns and climbs up. He places his old mask in the piles of blankets for Leaf to find. He places a hand on the tree close to the shrine she made. After a few moments praying silently before heading back to town.
